[b]September 5, 2026: Mobilising the State[/b]

An eerie silence hung over the city of Tharkønn, anxious crowds seemed to mill about on the street corners and on the public transportation, the Gøsfodde had been in meeting for about eight hours now as the provisions of a potential mobilisation order were looked into and debated. Market Indices had slid ten points over-night and another twelve just after opening, and investors were unnerved. 

A crowd had gathered once again at the entrance to the National Cathedral, a communique had been released by the office of the patriarchate to listen for the tone of the Great Bell, which would signal the decision of the Gøsfodde. 

True to the communique the bell at 11 AM began to tone out a long solemn sound, echoing in the city, news stations immediately switched to breaking news mode and broadcasts across the country were interrupted with a simple set of sentences.

[i]Today the Gøsfodde has authorised the partial mobilisation of the armed forces of Thýven in response to the aggression by both anti-socialist and EDU members in the White Strait. Thýven remains committed to the stability of Tallisland and supports its peoples right to self-determination[/i]

Immediately markets dropped by another twenty points before defense companies would end up raising it by 50 points, with it steadily climbing. 

On the military front jets and ships were being scrambled as communications were sent to Shamat to ready the forces there for immediate deployment to a holding pattern. In the meantime the patriarchate approved the transfer of five mid-range ICBMs and their teams to the nation of Flousech across from Tallisland, citing a mutual defense agreement that had been signed by the two nations in July. 

The second carrier fleet in the Shamat Sea would be ordered to return to the Free Republic of Knygta and Deyn for further orders. In the meantime the first carrier fleet off the coast of Tallisland was ordered to move to the coast of Flousech. 

A communique would be quickly sent to the government of Flousech requesting permission for the armed forces of Thýven to land its jets and planes in Flousech in a holding pattern. Noting their recent mobilisation as well.
